connector.registryDescription: Personal wiki and memory for AI assistants: store, search, and recall structured notes.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package brains-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the spacecowboyian account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
